title: Bluemercury appoints Stacie Borteck Dattner as Head of Merchandising
summary: The luxury beauty retailer has announced Stacie Borteck Dattner as its upcoming Vice President/General Merchandise Manager, Merchandising. The appointment is effective on October 12. In this role, Dattner will be responsible for the beauty retailer's next chapter of brand curation. She will lead Bluemercury's merchandising strategy, proprietary brands, and vendor marketing, guiding the retailer's assortment and strengthening its distinctive point of view on luxury beauty.
